name: Spell Industrialization

gist.Pyroblast: Hits any number of targets he likes and drops one Pollution Token on his own side per target.
gist.Pollution Spewer: An artifact that sits on the board as a creature; whenever a Pollution Token leaves his side it shoots a target.
gist.Pollution Piranha: Free creature summoned by removing a Pollution Token; nips a target each turn. When it leaves the board he loses a card from hand.
gist.Victorica, the Eternal Empress: Removes one older Pollution Token every turn.
gist.Mana Mining: Ability that makes polluting spells cheaper to cast, level by level.
gist.Eraser Beam: Once per game, for three tokens and as his only spell that turn: one of your targets is simply defeated.
gist.Rain of Arrows: Hits your whole side, harder for every creature he controls.
gist.Goldify: Destroys a creature and pays him gold.
gist.Magic Mirror: Face-down trap: cancels a spell aimed at its hero and casts a copy back.
gist.Rain of Death: Deletes every non-starting Ability on the board, both sides.
gist.Reincarnation: Fully revives a hero once, or returns a creature.
gist.The Great Clock Tower \"Big Gwen\": Area (Cooldin fetches it): tokens no longer force him to throw cards away at once.
gist.Ingo, Investor of Evil: Gold every time a creature lands on his side.
gist.Cooldin, King of Coolness: Plays an Area from the deck regardless of level, ending the turn.

plan: Ashton plays powerful spells on credit. Pyroblast hits as many targets as he likes and leaves a Pollution Token in his own support zones for each; every token shrinks his hand limit. Then he launders them: Victorica lifts one a turn, every Piranha is summoned by removing one, and each token that leaves fires a Pollution Spewer. With Piranhas and Spewers on the board Rain of Arrows hits your whole side, and once per game Eraser Beam just removes a hero. It is slow to start, his zones clog, the engine is small creatures, and his three heroes are fragile.

looks.early: Mana Mining on Victorica, Big Gwen overhead, one Pollution Spewer.
looks.mid: Grey tokens in his support zones, Piranhas and Spewers between them, a shot every time a token is cleaned away.
looks.late: Zones choked with tokens, three kept conspicuously free, Ashton smiling at one of your heroes.

opening.tell: He has spent two turns on Mana Mining and Big Gwen and has one Spewer on the board.
opening.why: His heroes are fragile and unprotected while he builds, and every turn you give him brings the Pyroblast turns closer.

midgame.tell: Piranhas and Spewers sit between the tokens in his support zones.
midgame.why: Those small creatures are the whole engine: a sweep kills them, each dying Piranha costs him a card, and without them Rain of Arrows and the token shots do nothing.

crisis.tell: He is keeping exactly three support zones free and has cast no spell this turn.
crisis.why: Eraser Beam needs three free zones and must be his only spell of the turn: Homerun! cancels a defeat by effect, so keep it for the hero carrying the Storm rather than spending the turn building.

endgame.tell: Every one of his support zones holds a token and Reincarnation is used.
endgame.why: With no room for tokens he cannot pay for his own spells; he is out of gas and simply needs to be finished.

opening.board: Cooldin fetches Big Gwen and the turn ends; Victorica attaches Mana Mining.
A Pollution Spewer clanks into place; his first Pyroblast clips two of your heroes.
He sets a card face-down on Cooldin and keeps four cards.

options.text: Aim at Victorica and Ingo instead

midgame.board: Two Piranhas and two Spewers; Victorica lifts a token and a Spewer shoots.

options.text: Flame Avalanche: each Piranha costs him a card too
One shot at a Spewer, rest at heroes

midgame.board: Rain of Arrows with four creatures out hits your whole side.
Rain of Death strips every added Ability from both sides.

options.text: Artifacts and potions still work: clear his board
He lost Mana Mining too: press

crisis.board: Three zones kept free, no spell cast yet, his eyes on your Storm caster.

options.text: Kill the caster who would fire it
Attach more to the hero he is looking at

crisis.board: A Magic Mirror sits face-down in front of Victorica.

options.text: Storm ticks are not aimed: let them work
Trigger it with a throwaway spell
Fire your biggest spell into it
Shields up, then kill her again
It only works once: burn her

endgame.board: Every support zone of his holds a token.
One hero each; his has a Magic Mirror.

options.text: Storm and Acid Vial, neither is a spell aimed at him

endgame.board: Golden Ankh on Victorica for one more token lifted.
